key_features: SCHOOL SUPPLIES KIT: One 65-piece middle and high school school supplies kit that bundles writing, math, and geometry tools in a single prepacked box.
FOR STUDENTS AND PROGRAMS: The kit is great for back-to-school prep, classroom restocks, donation drives, and supply programs.

KIT CONTENTS: The kit includes a 1 in 3-ring binder with 2 pockets, 5-tab dividers, 100-ct ruled filler paper, a 70-ct spiral notebook, 2-pocket portfolios, a mesh pencil pouch, a 56-function scientific calculator, a compass with a 6 in protractor, a 12 in ruler, a dual-blade sharpener, 5 in scissors, 12 colored pencils, #2 pencils, stick pens, dry-erase markers (3-pack), highlighters (3-pack), glue sticks (4-pack), liquid glue, and pink erasers (4-pack).
PER RETAIL UNIT: Each retail unit is one middle and high school school supplies kit with 19 school supply items and 65 total pieces.
ONE BOX, LIST COVERED: The prepacked kit replaces a cart of single items, covering supply lists in one purchase.
